title: iPhone free for 5 min while 2 jobs wait

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 5 min (since 08:19Z; the lease of iphone-runner ran out). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: end-morph (owner fix-end-morph; its wait names the phone); i219-hydrate (owner fix-i219-hydrate; waits on the phone).
What unblocks it: the next of fix-end-morph, fix-i219-hydrate takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

The phone is free because its link is down (incident I-220); nobody can use it until the cable is re-plugged.
- Your step C-082 (re-plug the cable) brings it back. Fix A's last part then starts at once on my go.
What you need to do: run C-082 when you can.
